scope: Two general graph-level statements. Every external neighbor of a port belongs to any closed port clause or oriented clause on an edge from that port to an internal vertex. If such a clause is private, all selected external neighbors of the port equal its owner, preventing different outside owners from sharing that port. Fano geometry, the eight-selection directional classification, the two-owner six-vertex cap and joint loss accounting retain written proofs and are not claimed fully formalized.
